text:
emma-partnerships: ping — vendor (OrionCloud) just put a partial hold on one of our reserved rack shipments for the Dedicated Q4 pilot. Reservation ID `RSRV-97321`. Affects 3 racks bound for us-east-1, ship ETA now estimated 2026-04-14 instead of 2026-04-10. SI partner has final integration 2026-04-12 and expects canary capacity. Need triage + mitigation ASAP
raj-ops: on it. is this a customs/staging hold or vendor-side quality hold?
orioncloud-partner: heads up — it's a supplier QA hold on a PSU batch flagged during end-of-line. We've been told hold window ~72h while OEM replaces labels and runs quick burn tests. current optimistic ETA 4/14. apologies, escalating with OEM now.
lisa-logistics: possible mitigation — we have 1 cold rack in eu-west stage that can be reallocated. cross-region freight to us-east doorstop is ~24-36h if we expedite and pay uplift. can stage into our partner DC and have SI access for canary on 4/12 if they accept remote validation.
kevin-sales: customer comms question — SI team planned a public joint announcement tied to full canary. If we can provide a single rack or a hosted fallback, can we avoid shifting the announcement? prefer not to delay marketing.
mike-legal: quick flag — check Dedicated contract clause 3.2 (reservation credits) and the vendor SLA. if vendor hold >48h we should trigger credit clause and document timeline. i'll draft a short notice to attach to credit requests.
emma-partnerships: proposed mitigation plan:
• swap one eu-west cold rack -> canary for SI on 4/12 (lisa to confirm transit ETA + cost)
• open immediate on-demand burst in Hosted (route 10% canary traffic to hosted dedicated burst) — raj, can infra provision?
• ask Orion to escalate OEM replacement and provide written hold timeline for legal/finance
• delay public announcement by 48h only if none of the above ok (prefer soft-launch comms)
raj-ops: infra can spin up a hosted burst pool (2 GPUs, isolated namespace) within 2 hours once finance approves. need PO # or cost center.
lisa-logistics: freight uplift estimate = $4.2k (expedite door-to-door). transit ETA if we book now = 24h. i can also check air vs truck.
orioncloud-partner: we're escalating now. OEM says they can reduce to ~24h if they prioritize our batch — will confirm by EOD. i'll post OEM ticket and timeline.
mike-legal: drafting the short notice and holding language; will link to `RSRV-97321` and the vendor email thread. if vendor confirms <=24h we won't pursue credits.
kevin-sales: I'll message the SI PM and propose a soft internal canary on 4/12 + public announcement hold-and-ready for 4/14. also prepping a standby customer-facing note.
supply-bot: manifest update: `manifest/RSRV-97321` status=HOLD reason=OEM_PSU_LABEL; escalated=true timestamp=1769584357
emma-partnerships: action owners
• lisa: confirm uplift booking and ETA (due 2h)
• raj: provision hosted burst and share cost estimate (due 1h)
• orioncloud-partner: confirm OEM priority or updated ETA (due EOD)
• mike-legal: put together notice and credit checklist (due EOD)
• kevin-sales: coordinate SI comms and announcement plan (due 3h)
raj-ops: noted, i'll start provisioning and ping finance for cost center.
lisa-logistics: booking in progress, will update with booking ref and ETA.
orioncloud-partner: OEM prioritized, new ETA 24h. will send confirmation email and replacement manifest.
emma-partnerships: great — if OEM holds to 24h we should be fine with the eu-west swap + hosted burst. keep posts here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
